verdict.rationale: Column is a developer-focused bank and payments API platform. A product of this kind could plausibly offer AI-generated insights on account or transaction data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows only standard reports (CSV/JSON/Parquet), statements, unified transfer queries and an llms.txt docs file. Exporting data or publishing LLM-readable documentation is adjacent and does not count as in-product AI insights or suggestions, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
